topic: the first minute is the hardest
lines: #The hardest part of anything is the first *minute.*
Not the workout. Putting your shoes *on.*
Not the project. Opening the *laptop.*
Not the conversation. Saying the first *word.*
#Your brain hates *starting.*
So it gives you a hundred reasons to do it *later.*
Just one more coffee. One more video. One more *minute.*
#But here's the secret nobody tells you.
Once you start, the resistance *disappears.*
Five minutes in, you're not fighting anymore. You're *working.*
Momentum takes over, and suddenly it's *easy.*
#So stop trying to finish today.
Just *start.*
Tell yourself it's only one minute. Only one *rep.*
Only one *page.*
Your brain will believe it. And then you'll keep *going.*
Every great thing you admire started with someone just *beginning.*
Badly. Slowly. But *beginning.*
#Most people never lose because the work was too *hard.*
They lose because they never got past the first *minute.*
Today, win that minute.
Everything else *follows.*
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.
